about: Plan Milestone 4 item 1. The outcomes file has no entry for r2 (spec-run-manager.md 06 item 7: every request in the requests file must appear exactly once). So mark edits no note: both requests stay - [r] and no link line is written. The run carries on (spec-run-manager.md 04 item 19): mark exits 0 and the run reaches 'marked', waiting for flags-1. Per CONTRACT.md 4 item 1, mark moves the bad file to outcomes-refused.json and writes outcomes.json as [], so the real Edit guard runs (exit 0) and flags each research note the workflow wrote as unexpected-research-note. act edits nothing for that rule (CONTRACT.md 4 item 5), so the run reaches 'acted' with next_check null. Reading (see Gaps): mark exits 0, not 1, because the step ran and the run state moved on; 'refuses' in spec 06 item 7 means refusing the file, as 04 item 19 says.
